hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For each element we must count how many elements in arr1 and arr2 are strictly greater than it.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Dynamic point updates and range count queries are supported in logarithmic time by Binary Indexed Trees.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Coordinate compress all numbers in nums. Use two Fenwick trees to count elements strictly greater than current value, then route to arr1 or arr2.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Coordinate compression and two Fenwick trees for dynamic rank counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search through arrays takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary Fenwick trees and rank tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Coordinate compress numbers and use Binary Indexed Trees for greaterCount queries in logarithmic time.
